notes: synthetic: a session seen in full that changed a support agent's prompt (measured on evals) and shipped its settings screen, with one useful screenshot and one terminal screenshot

commits.subject: feat(support): refund agent confirms the order before promising a refund

sessions.headline: Refund agent asks for the order number before promising anything
sessions.summary: The refund agent used to promise refunds before checking the order existed; customers were told yes and then refused. The prompt now has it ask for and confirm the order first, and admins can set the refund window on a new settings screen.

turns.ask: stop the refund bot promising refunds it can't give
did: rewrote the refund agent prompt to confirm the order first
ran the refund-agent evals: 12/20 before, 19/20 after, separated better

turns.ask: let admins set the refund window
did: added a refund policy settings screen with a 14 to 90 day window

images.context: evals check refund-agent --reps 5 output in the terminal
The new refund policy settings screen with the refund window slider set to 30 days

edits.before: When a customer asks for a refund, reassure them and explain the refund will be processed.
edits.after: When a customer asks for a refund, ask for their order number and confirm the order exists and is inside the refund window before you promise anything. If it is outside the window, say so plainly.
